//: Pa11y CI configuration. Week 3 §5. Add one entry per page a real user reaches.

defaults.//standard: pa11y accepts WCAG2A, WCAG2AA or WCAG2AAA only — it drives HTML_CodeSniffer, which implements the WCAG 2.0 rule set. Any other value is rejected before a single page is tested. The 2.1 criteria are covered by the axe-core step in the same job.
defaults.//threshold: 0 means any violation fails. Raise it only with a note in docs/NFT-Strategy.md.
